description: This file contains the implementation of the ParagraphRenderer class within the MigraDoc rendering engine. It is responsible for formatting and rendering paragraph elements in a document, including handling line breaks, tabs, fields, images, hyperlinks, and layout calculations. It manages both the formatting and rendering phases, producing the visual representation of paragraphs in a PDF or similar output format.

classes.name: ParagraphRenderer
classes.description: Handles the formatting and rendering of paragraph elements, including line breaking, tab stops, fields, images, hyperlinks, and layout management within the MigraDoc document rendering process.

methods.name: Render
methods.description: Renders the paragraph by initializing rendering, adding outline if applicable, and rendering each line with proper layout and style.

methods.name: Format
methods.description: Formats the paragraph, performing line breaking, layout calculations, and handling page or area constraints.

methods.name: FinishLayoutInfo
methods.description: Calculates final layout details such as starting and trailing heights, and sets the layout info accordingly.

methods.name: GetFieldValue
methods.description: Retrieves the string representation of a document field, such as page number, date, or bookmark.

methods.name: RenderLine
methods.description: Renders a single line of paragraph content, including text, images, and other inline elements.
